You can search any of the following, or combine terms with spaces:

• Machine names, common abbreviations, and names without spaces, such as MacBook Pro, MBP, MacBookPro, and MBP2014
• Machine codenames, such as Gossamer and J185
• Identifiers: Model Number A1278, Model Identifier MacBookPro18,3, Gestalt ID 313, Part Number MC700CH/A, and EMC Number 3442
• Processor generations, families, Intel codenames, and models, such as M1 Pro, i7, Haswell, SNB, 4960HQ, T7700, PPC, and 7450; T1 and T2 security chips are also searchable
• Complete introduction years, such as 2014

Examples of combined searches: iMac M4, MacBook Air M2, MBP 2014, J185 iMac20,1, and Tsunami 9500.

Search is not case-sensitive.

Search limitations:

• Speed and configuration variants of the same machine may be combined into one entry. Search for the machine family—for example, use 8100 rather than 8100/80. Part Numbers such as MC700CH/A are still supported.
• Separate processor families and models with a space: use i7 4960HQ or 4960HQ, not i7-4960HQ. For processor searches, omit prefixes such as Intel, Apple, and PowerPC.
• Every term must match the same machine. Enter values directly, without field labels or other descriptive words: use J185, not “Codename: J185.”
• Detailed specifications such as clock speed, memory, storage, cache, core count, and ports are not searched.
• Only supported abbreviations are recognized; nicknames and spelling errors are not inferred. Years must contain exactly four digits, such as 2014; months are not searched.
